download_grasp_model: download a grasp model file from a URL to a specified local path if not already present
draw_grasp_rectangle: draw a colored grasp rectangle on an image at a given height, width, and angle
init_grasp_model: initialize a GraspModel with configurable sample count, patch size, and importance sampling parameters
predict_grasp: run grasp prediction on an image and return the selected grasp configuration with confidence score
save_predicted_grasp_image: save the scene image with the predicted grasp rectangle overlay to a file path
